component.name: D-Modem
component.summary: The front panel of the open V.92 softmodem

description.p: D-Modem is an open softmodem: V.92, V.90, V.34 and the older modulations, fax and voice, over a SIP call, a USB modem or a softmodem codec. This app starts it, dials and answers, changes its settings, shows each call's statistics and gives you a terminal on it, while your own programs (pppd, minicom, efax) use its device.
